_doc: Raw technology data of v7. Money in EUR (real), one exchange rate in v7: 1 EUR = 1.1188 USD (Banca d'Italia 26/10/2026), 1.17 EUR/GBP, 25 CZK/EUR. Sources in research/v7_*.md and hydrogen.md. 'novel' = no commercial plant: cases 'first' (first plant) and 'target' are both reported. Rates: 5% real for all, except nuclear and SMR (financing cases).

disp.name: IMPORT
disp.src: existing 11.535 GW (ARERA 366/2025); blocks Terna/ARERA (v7_storage_flex.md sez.8.2); total new 7.33 GW = Terna 2040 need (Nord 4.38 + Est 1.85 + Nord Africa 1.10). Price: PUN 2025 average 115.94 EUR/MWh (GME), varied x0.5 and x1.5. Credit 38% = 4.4/11.5 (capacity market 2025). No export modelled. Availability in the 5% worst weeks of each year (lowest mean of normalised PV and onshore profiles, 3 weeks/yr) = 38% (cases 0 and 100%). Price in the 3 critical weeks/yr = PUN x 1.17: ratio of the mean IT_NORD day-ahead price in those weeks to the annual mean, years 2016-2019 (OPSD time series 2020-10-06; weeks: 2016 w3,42,49; 2017 w41,44,46; 2018 w37,40,44; 2019 w34,41,42; ratios 1.34,1.17,1.19,1.02). Sensitivities x1, x2, x3.

disp.name: CSP
disp.src: Yield: Andasol 1-3 (50 MW, 7.5 h storage, DNI 2136) guaranteed net 165 GWh/yr = 3307 h/MW (Dinter, Operation experience, SolarPACES/SASEC; observed annual output not found), scaled linearly by DNI 1875 (middle of 1800-1950 for Sicily, given by the coordinator, not measured by us) = 2903, rounded 2900. ENEA 2026 4100 MWh/MW at Priolo is a simulation for a 1 MW plant with 50000 m2 per MW (81.5 kWh/m2), solar multiple not stated: not used. Capex first plant: Andasol 1 EUR 310 M for 49.9 MW (2008), SolarPACES USD 10618.6/kW in 2020 USD / 1.1188 = 9491 EUR/kW (only European plant with a published cost and 7.5 h storage; recent Spanish plants such as Solgest-1 do not publish cost); target: IRENA 2024 world average 3677 USD/kW / 1.1188 = 3287 EUR/kW. Credit: mean over the top 1% load steps of min(1, daily budget on that day / 4 h) with the daily budget from the national PV profile; 10 GW is OUR ceiling (not sourced); sensitivity 3 GW (c3).
